item.title: Imminence and Authority: What Law Governs a Presidential Strike on Iran?

item.title: Spy Gun and Status Symbol: Russia’s PSM Compact Pistol
item.description: Designed for discreet KGB carry rather than battlefield firepower, the ultra-thin Soviet PSM pistol traded stopping power for concealment, mystique, and a lasting reputation as both spy gun and status symbol. #PSM #ColdWarWeapons #SovietFirearms #KGB #RussianMilitary #ConcealedCarryHistory #MilitaryHistory #SpyWeapons #FirearmsHistory #IntelligenceHistory

item.title: The USS Ford Toilet Story Is Real: Here’s What It Says About the U.S. Navy
item.description: A clogged toilet on a $13-billion aircraft carrier makes for easy propaganda, but it doesn’t ground the air wing, sideline the strike group, or signal the fall of American sea power — it just means sailors are fixing pipes while the ship stays on mission. #USNavy #USSGeraldRFord #AircraftCarrier #NavalPower #CarrierStrikeGroup #MilitaryReadiness #SeaPower #DefenseNews #OperationalTempo #Warship

item.title: The Bolduc Brief: The Power of Service Over Self: The Importance of Discernment in Leadership
item.description: The tape over your heart carries the weight of the mission, and when you let that matter more than the one with your own name on it, discipline stops being a rule and becomes a choice to serve something greater than yourself. #DonBolduc #Leadership #SelfDiscipline #Accountability #MissionFirst #ServiceBeforeSelf #EthicalLeadership #OrganizationalCulture #TeamIntegrity #LeadByExample

item.title: The Spell You’re Already Under: How Words Secretly Tell You Who To Be… And Why You Should Stop Wanting To Listen
item.description: Words don’t cast spells over your life, they just build frames, and if you’re not paying attention to who built the frame and why, you’ll start mistaking someone else’s narrative for your own truth. #TeganBroadwater #CriticalThinking #MediaLiteracy #LanguageMatters #NarrativeControl #Psychology #LawEnforcement #Communication #WordPower #Culture

item.title: Homeland Defense Is No Longer Theoretical
